page.overview:
Who is Ice?

Ice was a Cryomancer from Earthrealm and member of the Lin Kuei clan. He appeared in Malibu Comics Mortal Kombat: Kitana and Mileena.

Ice and the Lin Kuei were offered a place of power in the kingdom of Shao Kahn in return for the head of King Jerrod. He seemed to be afraid to die in kombat. One of his abilities was to send a volley of ice shards (Death-Circle Barrage).
